scripts.dev:electron: concurrently -k -s first -n ui,electron "bun --filter @agent-manager/ui dev --host 127.0.0.1" "wait-on http://127.0.0.1:5173 && bun --filter @agent-manager/desktop dev"
scripts.smoke:electron: concurrently -k -s first -n ui,electron "bun --filter @agent-manager/ui dev --host 127.0.0.1" "wait-on http://127.0.0.1:5173 && AGENT_MANAGER_SMOKE=1 bun --filter @agent-manager/desktop dev"
scripts.typecheck: bun --filter @agent-manager/ui check && bun --filter @agent-manager/desktop typecheck && bun --filter @agent-manager/server typecheck
